pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-clips/src/render.rs:127 The poster's text wrap decides where lines break by counting characters, not by measuring the rendered width at the font size, so a long unbroken token or a run of wide glyphs can overflow the 1080 px poster with no error and no coded finding.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-clips/src/render.rs:127 The rule says: when text is drawn, measure the widest line on the canvas and shrink to fit it; never rely on a character count. This wrap relies on a character count.

crates/shadowrunr-clips/src/footage.rs:398 Lines that were never voiced are burnt in with their own 'Unheard' style, and a missing tool or recording leaves a poster plus a fallback_reason instead of a faked video.
